description: Newcastle City Council (metropolitan, £250 threshold). Default is procurement_paid. Care Act Personal Data redactions appear as 'Redacted Personal Data' supplier name → bucket to direct_payment_individual. Tyne and Wear Pension Fund → internal_transfer.

rules.reason: Care Act 2014 + UK GDPR redactions — Newcastle uses 'Redacted Personal Data' as the canonical supplier name for direct payments to individuals.
Newcastle LGPS contributions to the Tyne and Wear Pension Fund (administered by South Tyneside MBC) are internal-transfer.
